patches.value: L_K=L(K)=(ℤx+ℤy+ℤh)⊗_ℤ K, formed from the abstract Chevalley generators in sl₂(ℂ), with bracket induced by [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=−2y, [x,y]=h. Once preservation of the lattice by these operators is established, its action on V_K is the tensor extension of that lattice action. This is the Chevalley construction also when p=2.

Set QJ=ℚ⊗_R J. By N003, the images 1⊗c0 of a finite generating set of J span QJ over ℚ, so QJ is finite-dimensional. The multiplication map is given on pure tensors by ρ⊗c0↦ρc0∈ℂ, with ρ∈ℚ and c0∈J; it is well-defined by R-balancing. Since ℚ is the fraction field of R⊂ℚ (H001), a common nonzero denominator in R combines any finite tensor sum into d0^(-1)⊗c0 with 0≠d0∈R and c0∈J. The image of such an expression is c0/d0; a zero image implies c0=0 and hence a zero tensor. Thus multiplication is injective and identifies QJ with the rational span of J.

value.declaration: Use arbitrary ρ∈ℚ as the scalar in the pure-tensor map formulas.
Use c0∈J as the bound numerator variable in pure tensors and common-denominator representations.
Use d0∈R as the bound denominator variable; inverse expressions are only used when d0≠0.
